name: Mai'Zoth
summary: In the eastern mountains of Stranglethorn Vale, Mai'Zoth keeps a relic said to twist minds. Brother Nimetz believes the ogre mage corrupted Colonel Kurzen and wants the relic recovered before another commander suffers the same fate.

sections.title: The Source of Corruption
sections.body: Brother Nimetz believes the power behind Kurzen's rebellion remains. His research points to Mai'Zoth, an ogre mage who lives in an ogre mound in the eastern heights of Stranglethorn Vale. Nimetz says Mai'Zoth used sorcery to warp Kurzen's thoughts. While Mai'Zoth lives, another commander could suffer the same corruption.

sections.title: Securing the Relic
sections.body: Brother Nimetz asks you to slay Mai'Zoth and take the Mind's Eye from him. Bring the artifact to the Rebel Camp.

sections.title: After the Delivery
sections.body: Brother Nimetz blesses whoever brings him the Mind's Eye. He plans to study its power and learn whether it can serve good. If it cannot, he says it must be destroyed.

faq.answer: Mai'Zoth is an ogre mage who lives in an ogre mound in the eastern mountains of Stranglethorn Vale. Brother Nimetz believes Mai'Zoth's sorcery corrupted Colonel Kurzen's mind.
Mai'Zoth holds the Mind's Eye, an artifact reputed to wield magic that controls minds. He uses it to corrupt and influence others.

faq.q: Why does Brother Nimetz want Mai'Zoth slain?
faq.answer: Brother Nimetz fears Mai'Zoth's corruption could turn someone else into another Kurzen, so he wants the ogre slain.

angles.text: Brother Nimetz works from the Rebel Camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale. He seeks Alliance champions to end the hidden evil that corrupted Kurzen.
